'''Yuvern''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the two-headed, [[Snake/Legends|snakelike]] [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernians]]. One young Yuvernian, [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]], dreamed of leaving his homeworld and becoming an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]], and he was eventually taken offworld by the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]]. By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the Yuvernian had become a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], whose first assignment took Adiss back to Yuvern. Arriving in-[[Yuvern system/Legends|system]], the Yuvernian encountered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]]. Subsequently, an unexpected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attack]] on the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] prevented Imperial [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] from discovering Adiss's illegal cargo, and the smuggler was later able to finish his mission to Yuvern.

==Description==
Yuvern was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DB" /> located in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]], a part of the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA Yuvern" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:CaneAdiss-SWChronicles.png|thumb|right|200px|Yuvern was the homeworld of the Yuvernians, including Cane Adiss.]]
The [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernians]],<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Yuvern,<ref name="DB" /> were already known to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="BoS" /> by [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="6900 BBY">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' establishes that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sorzus Syn]] knew of the [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernians]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exiles]] arrived in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]] in the aftermath of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates the end of that conflict to [[6900 BBY]].</ref> At some point, the Yuvernian [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Yuvern. In his youth, Adiss longed to leave Yuvern and [[Scout/Legends|explore]] the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], but his [[parental collective]] admonished him for not paying attention to the matters of his homeworld. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] Adiss had come of age, Yuvern was visited by the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]], who took the Yuvernian offworld and taught him to become a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. The pair eventually parted ways on<ref name="DB" /> the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], after which Adiss attempted to obtain a loan for a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from the local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]],<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].<ref name="DB" />

The Hutt employed Adiss as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], but to the Yuvernian's dismay, his first assignment,<ref name="DB" /> given by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">{{DB|character|caneadiss|Adiss, Cane}} places [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss's]] first mission in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as the [[battle in the Yuvern system]]. In addition, [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] states that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vernan (general)|Vernan]] was still alive eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after that engagement. Finally, ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' establishes that Vernan had [[Death/Legends|died]] by the time of the sourcebook's setting. Since ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]"&mdash;corresponding to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''&mdash;Adiss must have traveled to Yuvern on behalf of Jabba at some point by 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> took him back to his homeworld. Upon arriving in the Yuvern [[Star system/Legends|system]], Adiss discovered that the entire [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was also present. The smuggler was forced to let Imperial [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] aboard [[Adiss's ship|his ship]]; however, before Adiss's illegal cargo could be discovered, the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was unexpectedly [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attacked]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Line of battle|battle line]]. The [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] aboard Adiss's ship then ordered the Yuvernian to regroup with the rest of the retreating fleet at [[Harrod's Planet]]. After [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] the Imperials per his orders, Adiss returned to Yuvern and finished his assignment for Jabba.<ref name="DB" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Yuvernian/Legends}}
Yuvern was the homeworld of the sentient Yuvernians, a species of long,<ref name="DB" /> two-headed, [[Snake/Legends|snakelike]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|11|Adiss, Cane}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Yuvern was a planet first mentioned in the ''Rebel Alliance Sourcebook''; ''[&hellip;]'' The events surrounding Cane's return to Yuvern (as well as Yuvern itself) are from a vignette in the ''Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'' about Alliance Intelligence.|John Hazlett|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|jSarek|2|Behind the Scenes - Cane Adiss}}</ref>}}
The planet Yuvern was created as part of the backstory for Cane Adiss,<ref name="DB" /> a background character appearing in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> [[John Hazlett]],<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> writing as "jSarek," submitted an entry for Adiss<ref name="DB" /> through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]," and it was added to the site's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[August 31]], [[2006]].<ref name="What's The Story">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060831.html|text=What's the Story, Round 6}}</ref>

Addressing the origins of his story's subject matter, Hazlett later erroneously stated that the planet Yuvern was first mentioned in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'',<ref name="Blog" /> a [[1990]] [[West End Games]] supplement published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', although only the Yuvern system is mentioned in both the first<ref name="RAS1">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|second editions]] of that book.<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Yuvern system, and therefore the planet Yuvern, in grid square M-5.<ref name="TEA Yuvern" />
